'''Desnoy First Dark Side Deck I post''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Desnoy]]
* '''Published:''' 7 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 NMNPND Desnoy DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the first time I post a deck, I've always have a lot of problem building a deck so all comment will be welcome :)

The published list has 59 cards.
